verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of automatic type inference for component props or emitted events; the docs items are generic taglines and navigation links (e.g. Tooling Guide) with no TypeScript inference content. The community evidence points the other way: one developer reports having to declare prop types manually with PropType casts, and another calls TypeScript support second-class. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is an applicable axis with no supporting evidence, so the verdict is none rather than disputed.
